Class Restaurant

java.lang.Object
entity.Restaurant
public class Restaurant extends Object
The restaurant: its tables, the waiting queue, every customer who has arrived, the menu and the staff.

It answers questions the controller and the console need, such as "which tables are free?", and it is the only place that seats a customer.

    • seat

      public void seat(Customer customer, Table table) throws InvalidActionException
      Seats a queued customer at a free table. This is the only method that seats anyone, so the Waiter or future Host both call it.

      Every rule is checked before anything changes, so a refused seating leaves the queue, the table and the customer exactly as they were.

      Parameters:
      customer - the customer to seat
      table - the table to use
      Throws:
      InvalidActionException - if the customer is not waiting in the queue, no table is given, or the table is occupied
